subject: Startup credits request — special terms for Q3 cohort
messages:
From: Emily Ross <emily@launchpadvc.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus AI <founder@nimbusai.com>
Date: 2025-07-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Startup credits request — special terms for Q3 cohort

Hi Rafael,

We're putting together the benefits package for our Q3 LaunchPad cohort and Nimbus AI (cc'd) is one of the standouts — they'll likely go fast on tokens once they graduate. Our standard ask across partners is to secure larger, short-term credits that they can move into production with.

Two specific asks from Nimbus:
- A one-off promotional credit larger than the standard $10k starter — they're requesting $50k to cover an initial pilot and hack week.
- Longer expiry window (6 months vs. your standard 90 days) or the ability to apply a portion of unused credits to the first paid invoice.

We appreciate your published program rules but wanted to surface whether Redwood can make an exception for a cohort company that will drive adoption across the wider LaunchPad community. If there's a standard flex path or approval process, please let us know what you need from our side (form, PO, legal).

Thanks — Emily
Emily Ross
Head, Partnerships — LaunchPad Ventures
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily@launchpadvc.com>
Cc: Nimbus AI <founder@nimbusai.com>
Date: 2025-07-12T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Startup credits request — special terms for Q3 cohort

Hi Emily — thanks for the context and congrats to Nimbus. I can move on this but will need to run a one-off through our internal approvals. Quick proposal from our side that I think balances risk and value:

- Offer: $50,000 in promo credits (applies to API usage)
- Expiry: 180 days from issuance
- Post-trial: 20% off list for the first 3 paid months if they convert within the promo window
- Conditions: Redwood to be listed as LaunchPad production partner in cohort materials (short logo + 1-sentence blurb)

If that sounds acceptable, I need a short Ask approval from Sales Manager and one from Finance for the extended expiry. I'll draft the promo terms and send for signatures (DocuSign).

cc: Monica Patel (AE) and Stephanie Nguyen (Sales Manager) to confirm approval path.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-13T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Startup credits request — approval notes

Raf / Monica — quick internal note after review with Finance: we're OK to make an exception with two edits to your proposal.

1) Expiry window: Finance prefers 120 days (4 months) rather than 180. That reduces our unrecognized liability and keeps the conversion signal higher.
2) Pilot discount: instead of a flat 20% for three months, cap the discounted amount to the equivalent of $10k in billable usage (so the max $ discount is $2k per month x 3 months).

If LaunchPad needs the marketing placement, that's fine — just capture it in the campaign name and we need a short co-marketing one-pager.

Approve subject to those two edits. Rafael — can you confirm back to Emily and attach the revised promo_terms.pdf?

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
